utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is getting a few more hands today, mostly folks bringing tools and spare parts from around the block. If you’re headed over, I’d go early before the good stuff runs out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll stick to my usual plan and go early, then. Best to get there before everything useful is picked over.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s the smart move. I heard they’re hoping to sort the tools by noon, so early birds should have the best shot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m on it — just give me the quick version and I’ll get moving.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Quick version: bring the tools, meet me at the repair drive, and we’ll sort the rest there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll bring the tools and head to the repair drive now.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Do we have confirmation and a source for the repair drive details? I’m not changing my stance without something I can verify.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I don’t have confirmation yet, so I’m not treating it as settled. Let’s pin down a verifiable source before we move any further.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That’s fair — send me the source when you have it, and I’ll take another look.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help, but I may be a bit fuzzy on the details; what were we fixing again?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We were fixing the loose steps by the west gate, and I’ve noted a need for nails, a pry bar, and two willing hands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah yes, the west gate steps—that’s the one. I can lend a hand, and if you’ve got the nails and pry bar lined up, I’m ready to follow your lead.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to verify the details first before I commit to anything. What’s the current status of the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m not fully up to speed right now, so I don’t want to give you stale info. Let me check the latest and get back to you with the current status.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that works for me—please get the latest before I make any decisions.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, I’m a bit late—what’s the plan for the repair drive so far?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries—right now we’re just gathering tools and seeing who can help this afternoon. I’ll spread the word and keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I'll help round up tools, and if anyone needs an extra hand this afternoon, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help out with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great — thanks, Sam. I’m still sorting the list, so I’ll get back to you with whatever needs fixing most.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — just point me at the worst one when you’ve got it sorted, and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive details tracked precisely — just point me to the location you need, and I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s a lifesaver—can you do the one by the school on Maple? I need it wrapped up before pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll take care of the Maple one by the school first and have it wrapped before pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a good turnout already—people are really stepping up. I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear anything more solid.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s fantastic—thanks, Tess! I’ll keep spreading the word and make sure everyone who can help knows where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course—if I hear any updates, I’ll pass them along right away. Fingers crossed it keeps building!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Mostly the usual stuff: a few loose fixtures, some worn wiring, and whatever else folks spot when we check around. If you want, I can help list it out from the last walk-through.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes—list the specific items from the last walk-through, and note which ones are urgent.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m hearing repair drive, so I’m hearing repair drive—we should keep it simple and get everyone pointed the same way. I’ll spread the plan once we know the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds good to me—I’m still catching up, so the simpler the plan, the better. Let me know what details I should pass along once they’re set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely—once we lock the details, I’ll repeat the same simple plan to everyone and keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Got it — I’m on it, and I’ll keep everyone updated if anything shifts. Let’s make sure the repair drive plan stays clear for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks. I’ll stick to what I know and pass along anything certain.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll do the same and only share confirmed updates. If anything changes, I’ll flag it right away so nobody’s left guessing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive’s getting a nice little turnout already — folks seem pretty eager to help out. I’m still waiting to hear the final details, but it’s looking promising!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s good to hear. I’d still like the final details before I settle on anything, but a promising turnout is a fine start.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, totally fair — I’ll keep my ears open and let you know as soon as I hear the final details.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — the plan’s still to get folks together, sort the donations, and knock out the most urgent fixes first. If that’s what everyone’s leaning toward, I’m happy to keep pushing that version.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’m with that. I can help sort donations and tackle the urgent fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m ready to help with the repair drive—what should I handle first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Start with sorting the donated parts. I’ll check the list and tell you what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll sort the donated parts now and keep an eye out for anything unusual.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just give me the quick version and I’ll roll with it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Quick version: the repair drive is the one to back if you want the neighborhood cleaned up right — I’m pretty sure it’s the most direct way to get those fixes moving.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’m in for the repair drive. Just point me to the next step and I’ll keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help get the repair drive going—want me to spread the word and see who can pitch in?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That would help, but let’s confirm exactly what needs fixing first so we don’t waste anyone’s time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and help pin down the exact fixes first, then we can rally the right folks.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m a bit behind; what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’re still on for Saturday morning at the community center, and I’ve got the sign-up sheet ready. If you can bring the tool箱, that would really help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I can bring the toolbox on Saturday morning. Thanks for the reminder; I’m sorry I was behind on the update.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Heard the repair drive’s picking up a few more hands today—folks are dropping off tools and a little cash where they can. I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if there’s anything specific they still need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—just point me at whatever needs doing, and I’ll bring a few tools along too. I’m flexible on when and where, so I can jump in wherever it helps.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll ask around on my next run and see who’s short on what—tools, ladders, maybe a strong back or two. If I hear a specific gap, I’ll come straight back and point you there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help out with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. I’ll send you the list and the drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Leo — send it over and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let’s get the repair drive plan settled early—who’s handling what, and by when? I’d rather have the details nailed down now than sort them out last minute.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I need specifics before I sign off: who owns each task, and what are the exact deadlines?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good point—let’s assign each task now and put exact deadlines on them. Once it’s written down, we can both sign off with confidence.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, absolutely—we should get the word out right away. I’ll spread the invite fast and wide so everyone can pitch in for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Wonderful, Quinn. I’ll add your name to the list and note that you’re handling the invitations right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—I’m on it and will start inviting folks right away. We’ll get a good turnout for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help, but I’ll need to keep it around pickup times—what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—pickup times. I’m a bit hazy on the details, but I think we were aiming for Saturday, unless that’s changed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday could work if it stays tight—do we have a time and where to meet?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell — I’m on it and I’ll keep everyone posted if anything changes. Just tell me what you need for the repair drive, and I’ll double-check the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — could you double-check the date, time, and where folks should drop things off? I’m still learning everyone’s setup, so second-hand details help a lot.
